messages:
maya: quick heads-up — qint4 bringup for nova13b shows ~6% recall drop on the multilingual paraphrase promptset vs float (notable in zh/es). canary id eval-run/1749004000. baseline float=0.882, qint4=0.822 :frowning:
diego: ugh. which exact promptset path and config?
maya: promptset: s3://redwood-evals/promptsets/multilang_paraphrase/v2/*. eval harness: repo redwood/evals:tools/multilang_paraphrase_eval.py. canary config: --seq-len 512 --temp 0.0 --k=1
olivia: did we change tokenizer merges or vocab for the qkernel? tokenization drift can look like recall loss.
sam: I deployed qkernel tweak yesterday (latency improvement). not aware of token change. pinging @naya for labeling / golden capacity.
naya: labeler capacity is low this week (holiday), but we can pull ~2k golden if we prioritize. should we target-edge examples?
maya: plan proposal: 1) collect 3k edge paraphrase pairs from low-confidence buckets (prioritize zh, es, fr, pt). 2) de-dupe + quick golden label pass (correctness/intent). 3) re-eval qint4 vs float with augmented goldset.
diego: for de-dupe use fingerprint + fuzzyhash. example command:
```
python tools/dedupe_bank.py --input s3://redwood-evals/ingest/lowconf/*.jsonl --out s3://redwood-evals/curation/multilang_qdrop_pool/ --threshold 0.82
```
olivia: also run token alignment diff to spot tokenization regressions:
```
python scripts/token_diff.py --model nova13b --samples 3000 --out /tmp/tokendiff.json
```
sam: I can reserve dedicated canary infra tonight and run the full sweep (seq-len 1024 as well). scheduling now.
naya: I'll open a high-priority label queue (labelflow) and tag it multilang-qdrop-2026-03. ETA ~48h for 2k samples, 72h for 3k if we need manual review on synths.
maya: optional: synth fill for low-resource langs via backtranslation to hit counts faster. quick synth snippet:
```
# synth backtranslation pipeline (very small bounce sample)
for lang in zh es fr pt:
  python tools/synth_bt.py --lang $lang --count 500 --out s3://redwood-evals/curation/synth_bt/$lang/
```
olivia: caution: synthetic examples can bias metrics. mark 10% for manual QC.
eval-bot: new eval started by sam at 1749004000 — https://evals.redwood.internal/runs/1749004000 (artifacts staging). :eyes:
diego: once goldset is ready, run compare and produce regression diffs:
```
python evals/compare.py --baseline float --candidate qint4 --gold s3://redwood-evals/curation/multilang_qdrop_gold_v2/ --out /tmp/qdrop_diff.json
```
maya: decision tree: if recall drop persists >3% after gold augmentation -> rollback qkernel and bisect. if <3% then try per-layer fallback for quant or increase per-token precision for problematic layers.
naya: labeling nuance: I'll tag examples with flags (ambig, deid, synth) so downstream evals can filter.
maya: thanks. @sam please post canary logs + eval-bot run link when finished. :thumbsup:
sam: kicking off now on dedicated pool. will ping when done. :rocket:
eval-bot: canary finished at 1749005235 — artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-eval-artifacts/1749005235/"
